overview: The Medford School Committee approved delaying the transition to a potential new middle school grade configuration and voted on several key design components of the Medford Comprehensive High School project, including rejecting dedicated rental storage space, maintaining a teen health center, and setting LEED v4 certification goals.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Approved a motion to enter executive session to discuss strategy for Medford Teachers Association litigation.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the bills, payrolls, and minutes from the June 15 and July 10, 2026 meetings.

items.title: Introduction of New District Staff
items.summary: Superintendent Galusi introduced Katie Doucette as the Managing Director for Before and After School programming and Ryan Pike as the new Facilities Director.

items.title: Grade Configuration and Task Force Update
items.summary: Approved a motion to delay the earliest start date for a potential middle school grade configuration transition to the 2028-2029 school year.

items.title: MCHS Building Project: Community Partner Storage
items.summary: Approved a motion to not build any dedicated storage space for rental use in the new Medford High School building, prioritizing school educational needs instead.

items.title: MCHS Building Project: Teen Health Center
items.summary: Approved a motion recommending that the High School Building Committee maintain a teen health center space in the project planning documents.

items.title: MCHS Building Project: Sustainability Goals
items.summary: Approved a motion to target a minimum of LEED v4 silver certification, prioritizing healthy materials to capture an additional one percent MSBA reimbursement and aiming for net-zero energy.

items.title: Resolution 2026-06
items.summary: Tabled the resolution to the August meeting to allow the committee more time to review the final document.

items.title: Resolution 2026-17: K-12 Statewide Graduation Council Recommendations
items.summary: Approved a resolution directing the curriculum and instruction subcommittee to meet by October 15, 2026, to review the district's alignment with state graduation framework recommendations.

items.title: Resolution 2026-18: State Delegation Funding Appreciation
items.summary: Approved a resolution expressing gratitude to the Medford state delegation for securing $632,000 in school funding through state and supplemental budgets.

items.title: Resolution 2026-19: Support for Immigrants Affected by TPS Terminations
items.summary: Approved as amended a resolution affirming support for students, staff, and families affected by Temporary Protected Status terminations.

items.title: Facilities Subcommittee Referral
items.summary: Approved a motion directing the facilities subcommittee to meet and discuss the rental storage situation inside school buildings.
